raw_segments.text: When we got back again, and he lifted me out, and carried me, so easily.
Across the court and up the stairs, I thought of that eventful Christmas day when he had
We had not yet made any allusion to my change of fortune, nor did I know how much of my
late history he was acquainted with.
I was so doubtful of myself now, and put so much trust in him, that I could not satisfy
myself whether I ought to refer to it when he did not.
